_notice: Sample data bundled with CareerFlux for local development. These are not real job postings, the companies do not exist, and every apply URL points at example.invalid on purpose. Sources served from this file are typed LOCAL_FIXTURE and are labelled as sample data everywhere they appear in the UI.

jobs.title: Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Northwind Systems is looking for a Java Backend Developer to join the platform team.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and tune the queries behind it
  • Write tests that describe behaviour, not implementation
  • Review code and help teammates ship safely

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of professional backend experience
  • Strong Java fundamentals
  • Spring Boot and Spring Security in production
  • Comfortable with SQL and PostgreSQL
  • Git, Maven, and a CI/CD pipeline you have actually used

Nice to have

  • AWS or another cloud provider
  • Kafka or another message broker
  • Docker

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for the platform group.

Responsibilities

  • Own services end to end, from design through operation
  • Design microservices boundaries that survive contact with change
  • Mentor engineers earlier in their careers

Requirements

  • 5-8 years of backend experience
  • Java and Spring Boot at depth
  • Kubernetes and Docker in production
  • Kafka or equivalent event streaming
  • PostgreSQL, including schema migration strategy
  • System design experience on services with real traffic

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (React + Spring Boot)
jobs.description:
Lumen Analytics builds reporting tools for mid-market finance teams. We are looking for a full stack developer to work across our React frontend and Spring Boot services.

What you will do

  • Build features end to end, from the API to the screen
  • Work directly with the people who use the product

Requirements

  • 2-4 years building web applications
  • React and TypeScript
  • Java and Spring Boot
  • REST APIs
  • PostgreSQL

Nice to have

  • Experience with data visualisation
  • AWS

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Graduate)
jobs.description:
A graduate role for someone starting their backend career. You will be paired with a senior engineer for your first six months.

Requirements

  • 0-2 years of experience
  • Java fundamentals
  • An understanding of SQL
  • Willingness to learn Spring Boot

Nice to have

  • Any REST API you have built, including personal projects
  • Git
